serviceIdentification.serviceName: Palantir Federal Cloud Service – Supporting Services (PFCS-SS)
serviceIdentification.serviceAcronym: Palantir Federal Cloud Service – Supporting Services (PFCS-SS)
serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: PFCS-SS is a dedicated environment for the purpose of delivering best-of-breed commercial software to federal government customers as a secure cloud service at the FedRAMP High baseline. The software deployed to PFCS-SS is commercially available software configured to run on PFCS' Kubernetes infrastructure and leverage PFCS' management plane services.
